item.description: - AI spending is concentrated in a handful of giants, not spreading profit broadly yet. - Zafin's deal shows private equity-backed AI vendors are consolidating, not just raising. - Data centre opposition in Manitoba and elsewhere could slow AI infrastructure buildout. - Watch Manitoba Hydro's role as data centre power demands become politically sensitive. - AI-generated film is advancing technically but still lacks creative substance.

item.title: 2026-10-26 Health & Fitness: Weight Lifting's Longevity Payoff, Plus Drug Cost Strain
item.description: - Two hours of lifting weekly may be the real longevity sweet spot, not more. - Pairing strength work with cardio showed the biggest mortality drop in the study. - It's correlation over three decades, so treat it as supportive, not definitive. - A Vancouver patient's ninety thousand dollar monthly cancer drug bill is making headlines. - Oncologists say drug pricing, not care itself, is pushing the system toward a breaking point.

item.title: 2026-10-26 Parenting: Scary Season, Normal Fears, and Benefit Deadlines
item.description: - A little Halloween fear is developmentally normal, says the Canadian Paediatric Society. - Warning sign: fear that starts blocking school, sleep, or friendships. - Separation anxiety and fear of the dark are typical at young ages. - Persistent, out-of-proportion worry is the cue to see a pediatrician. - Useful context for clients navigating young kids this week.

item.title: 2026-10-26 Sports: Jets Fall Again, Raiders Routed, Rodgers Makes History
item.description: - Jets drop another one-goal game, now five without a win since the Hellebuyck trade. - Raiders fall to 3-4 after a 35-21 loss in Las Vegas to the Rams. - Aaron Rodgers passes Peyton Manning on the all-time touchdown list. - Vikings sit alone at 6-0 heading into the back half of the NFL season. - Brewers one win from a World Series title after another late comeback.
